description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP CDS view. Can check existing view (active/inactive) or validate hypothetical DDL source. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

ddl_name.description: CDS view name to check, passed as ddl_name.

ddl_source.description: Optional: DDL source code to validate instead of the saved version.

version.description: Version to check: 'active' or 'inactive'. Default: inactive.

name: CheckDdl
